scope: Private offline partial monitor. Original assigned slots and separately recorded controller-interruption replacements are mapped once per slot; original interrupted records remain preserved. Genuine completed timeouts and bad grades are retained. Prior48/12 reference cohorts remain separate; no significance claim. 95% pointwise t intervals are exploratory, not simultaneous; incomplete-cell observations may be completion-biased. Native quality and allocated GPU-time are separate; GPU-time excludes grading and is not utilization or billed cost. Timeout outcomes retained; missing values never zero.
